hooks.command: compass_hook_root="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$compass_hook_root/.agents/hooks/format-edited.mjs" ]; do if [ "$compass_hook_root" = / ]; then echo '[compass format hook] 找不到 Compass Hook 入口' >&2; exit 2; fi; compass_hook_root=$(dirname "$compass_hook_root"); done; exec node "$compass_hook_root/.agents/hooks/format-edited.mjs"
